title: The Lost Trail
author: Cyrus Pemberton
blurb: Coral Crane, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
